summary: Antiphon nightly tests (CARD-0487). Desktop tag. 00:30 Europe/London. No suite or ref override.
description:
SSH-bridge wrapper that runs scripts/nightly-run.ps1 against C:\Antiphon
ightly\checkout. Do not add a Windows Scheduled Task. The job exits with the SSH exit code; the wrapper's final stdout line is its compact JSON completion record (nativeRunId, sha, ref, trigger, localDueDate, policyHash, coverageComplete, testsPassed, reportDelivered, exitCode, summaryPath), which Windmill stores as the job result (CARD-0545 D-10). A failed SSH hop prints no record and fails the job.
content:
#!/bin/bash
set -uo pipefail
ssh -i /tmp/windmill/worker_to_windows -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes lndco@host.docker.internal 'powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\src\Antiphon\scripts
ightly-run.ps1'
exit $?
